scope: Design only; no game code changes
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished visual design presentation for an existing Chinese mobile hot-pot tile matching game, celadon theme 青瓷雅韵 only. This is a design proposal, not a screenshot of implemented code.
Input images are STYLE AND PRODUCT REFERENCES: image 1 existing gameplay, image 2 existing collection, image 3 existing settings/profile. Preserve their elegant celadon porcelain, creamy ivory, jade green, thin antique gold, bamboo courtyard, appetizing hand-painted realistic food assets, dimensional ceramic tile visual language, and exact brand “锅里捞啥”. Improve layout, not a rebrand.
Composition: a wide landscape board with THREE equally sized complete portrait mobile screens side by side, identical screen dimensions and top alignment, generous small gutters on an ivory neutral board. No device hardware, no arrows, no explanatory callouts covering UI. Small board label “青瓷雅韵 · 界面效果稿”. Left screen gameplay, middle collection, right settings. All three show EXACTLY THE SAME brand plaque “锅里捞啥”, same pixel width, height, font size and position, centered within each screen, about 68% screen width. Reserve comfortable WeChat top safe space. NOTHING flanks the brand plaque; remove upper-left giant book icon and upper-right gear. No controls compete with title.
All three screens have the SAME compact bottom navigation bar of three labeled controls “游戏” “图鉴” “设置”, graceful simple jade/gold icons above clear text. Highlight corresponding current page. Thus collection and settings entries relocate to bottom, independently of the title. Keep bottom safe inset.
LEFT gameplay: secondary banner “第3关·千层盛宴”; small remaining counter “剩余 36 / 72”. Large jade/gold framed cream porcelain board. A playable overlapping layered cluster of roughly 25 square food tiles, NOT cards or inventory grid. Normal food includes tofu cubes, rolled beef, mushroom, sliced bamboo shoot. Two accessible premium tiles among ordinary tiles show 松茸 and 羊肚菌. They have a distinct warm fine gold double rim, a delicate tiny gold “珍” corner seal, gentle jade-and-champagne halo hugging the tile edge and a few tiny light specks; keep food fully recognizable, no giant particle bursts, no opaque effect hiding the icon. Their base remains a matching ceramic square, subtly pearl gold rather than plain cream. Occluded tiles remain dim. Under board keep existing seven-slot holding tray, and two understated buttons “重新开始” and “声音：开”, then navigation. Main tile board dominates play area, not the navigation.
MIDDLE collection: same brand header; secondary banner “食材图鉴”. Two tabs “普通食材” and selected “珍藏食材”; small counter “已发现 6 / 10”. Six premium food cards in a 3-column x 2-row grid, well spaced, ivory text labels, exact readable names: “松茸”, “羊肚菌”, “黑松露”, “花胶”, “海参”, “鱼子酱”. No shellfish, no lobster, no crab. Appetizing hot-pot ingredients on small celadon plates. Each premium card has a beautiful luminous BACKGROUND: pearlescent jade/champagne silk-like wisps, a single soft diagonal flowing light sweep, fine gold border, restrained tiny glints and small “珍藏” badge. Effect must be clearly visible in the static mockup, luxurious but calm, food crisp in front, label area clear and high contrast. Leave airy breathing room. Tiny lower copy “每次相遇，都有新的惊喜。” No spawn rules or probability copy.
RIGHT settings: same identical brand header; secondary banner “我的小馆”. Clean ivory rounded player summary card labeled “本机玩家”, subtle avatar. A short stats card with “累计通关” “食材发现” “已获成就”; simple grouped rows “我的成就”, “地域榜单”, “所在地选择”, “页面换肤”, and “声音” with switch. Match existing page, restrained icons; ample spacing and empty room, bottom navigation selected 设置. No book icon beside title, no close button.
Typography: beautifully rendered exact Chinese brand and short labels, harmonious ink-jade calligraphy for brand and legible traditional-inspired UI text. Keep header visually identical across all 3 screens. Do not write internal mechanics, first-entry guarantee, drop probability, stage eligibility, technical text or English on screen. No watermark. High fidelity actual app UI design, not a photograph, not a poster with perspective phones.
